controlling_contract.action_order: PUBLISHED immutable root/receipt -> frozen consumer/derived port -> consumed ActionExecutionAdmission -> per-PCE CapturedPortAuthorization.v2 -> matching LifecycleCapturedReceipt.v2 -> complete signed CapturedAuthorizationSet.v2 -> distinct set-bound LaunchSession -> only then open/import/construct/run/publish.
controlling_contract.replay_order: replay PIS -> CES -> PEA -> private BVP/PCE -> equality -> replay CAS -> FinalReplayEntry -> Final Manifest -> FinalReplayAdmission -> consumed FinalReplayAdmission -> per-PCE port authorization -> matching v2 receipt -> complete signed set -> signed ReplayCaptureAdmissionEvidence.v1 -> distinct replay LaunchSession -> only then open/import/construct/run/publish.
controlling_contract.release_boundary: The closeout-plan phrase 'runtime/release equality' cannot add a field to an exact ADR object: LifecycleCapturedReceipt.v2 has actor_runtime_sha256 and no release-identity field.

exact_shapes.canonical_rules: Closed objects refuse missing/extra/duplicate keys. Signed self-digests use deterministic canonical bytes excluding only self/signature. Set entries are unique, strictly ascending by planned_entry_sha256, and one-for-one with PCEs. Entry/port/receipt/set/session/runtime bindings have identical execution authority ref, logical execution ID, and run ID.

adjacency_ledger.rule: PCE -> port authorization: exact planned entry, study/subject/execution tuple and PEA/CES/BVP/CAS chain; one authorization per PCE.
Frozen descriptor/derived port -> PCE/authorization: exact consumer document/node/input/purpose and descriptor root/snapshot/document/node/output/purpose; no alternate projection.
Consumed action/replay admission -> first port authorization: exact authority tag/digest, logical execution, run; WORM consumption before mint.
Port authorization -> v2 receipt: exact execution tuple, subject, plan chain, planned entry, and port-authorization digest.
PUBLISHED receipt/root -> v2 receipt: exact predecessor schema/digest and resolved immutable PCE root; ordered stream and WORM-unique nonce.
Measured actor runtime -> v2 receipt: exact actor_runtime_sha256; runtime substitution refuses. No receipt-to-release equality is asserted because this exact schema has no release field.
PCE/port/receipt triples -> set.entries: bijection by planned_entry_sha256; exact three digests; canonical order; no duplicate/missing/extra/alternate projection.
CES/BVP/CAS/stage-or-replay legs -> set: complete P(CES)==P(BVP)==P(CAS)==P(Stage)==P(Captured), or equivalent four replay pre-capture legs.
Verified action set -> distinct LaunchSession: exact study/execution tuple, consumer document, BVP, set digest, measurement, purpose, trusted time; action path remains set -> session.

Replay set -> ReplayCaptureAdmissionEvidence.v1 -> distinct LaunchSession: set uses literal replay FinalReplayAdmission ref and same logical execution/run; evidence binds exact study/final-manifest/final-admission/final-entry/replay/replay-intent/PEA/CES/BVP/planned-set/CAS/set digest; issued_ports equals set triples item-for-item in PCE order. Broker resolves exact Final Manifest, FinalReplayAdmission, verified evidence, and verified set before session; a replay set alone cannot mint a session.
LaunchSession -> runtime/member open: same nonserializable broker-bound identity; producer/same-run/same-session/restart substitution refuses before effect.
Port/receipt/set/replay evidence: exact issuance basis, role/use, Ed25519, inclusive trusted time, immutable fail-closed revocation snapshot.
Post-freeze source -> all later artifacts: recomputed document/descriptor bytes remain exact; mutation refuses before effect.

correction_mapping.skeptic-M02: Corrected by replay_order, exact ReplayCaptureAdmissionEvidence.v1 and issued_ports shapes, P4-C09-replay, owner decision, and replay RED rows. This makes the replay-only set -> evidence -> distinct session chronology explicit while retaining action set -> session.
correction_mapping.skeptic-M03: Corrected by P4-C06 and release_boundary: actor_runtime_sha256 remains exact; unsupported receipt-to-release identity and release substitution claims are removed. A future release binding needs a separate approved controlling contract.
